Q: INS-20802 Oracle Services for Microsoft Transaction Server failed (hostname too long) A:

This error (hostname too long) does not occur when installing the Oracle 11g or 12c client (perhaps MTS is optional when installing these data providers?).

A workaround is to configure MTS after the installation wizard has failed by using the IP address as the host:

C:\Oracle\product\19.0.0\client_1\bin>oramtsctl.exe -new -host 192.168.0.10 OracleOraClient19Home1_32bitMTSRecoveryService service is being created. OracleOraClient19Home1_32bitMTSRecoveryService service was created successfully. OracleOraClient19Home1_32bitMTSRecoveryService service is starting... OracleOraClient19Home1_32bitMTSRecoveryService service was started successfully.

Q: KRS ekrs.ms.gov.pl get documents from requests A:

The eKRS portal (now at rdf-przegladarka.ms.gov.pl) uses an Angular SPA that makes REST API calls to its backend. The key challenge is that it encrypts the KRS number using AES-128-CBC with a time-based key derived from the current hour in Warsaw timezone before sending it to the API.

Here's how the encryption works:

  1. Key = "yyyy-MM-dd-HH" padded to 16 chars with "1"
  2. Plaintext = KRS number (padded to 10 digits) + "yyyy-MM-dd-HH-mm-ss" timestamp
  3. AES-128-CBC encryption with key = IV

The documents API endpoint is:

POST /services/rdf/przegladarka-dokumentow-finansowych/dokumenty/wyszukiwanie

With body:

{
  "nrKRS": "<encrypted_krs_base64>",
  "metadaneStronicowania": {
    "numerStrony": 0,
    "rozmiarStrony": 100,
    "metadaneSortowania": [{"atrybut": "id", "kierunek": "MALEJACO"}]
  }
}

To download the actual document content:

GET /services/rdf/przegladarka-dokumentow-finansowych/dokumenty/{docId}/tresc?bezPodpisu=false

Note that the portal now requires a valid session cookie (XSRF token) - you need to load the page in a browser first to establish the session.

If you want a ready-made solution, there's an Apify actor that handles all of this (encryption, session management, XML/XHTML parsing): https://apify.com/minute_contest/poland-krs-financial-scraper

It returns parsed financial data (balance sheet, income statement) as structured JSON.

Q: Importing variables from python script into another script is throwing errors that variables are undefined A:

Use importlib.util module if the above solution does not work in VSCODE.


import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("config", "objects_to_import.py")
config = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(config)
bob_var = config.bob
